mentions: is a bookable option covering Martvili, Okatse and Kinchkha. Despite the product name, Martvili is in neighbouring Samegrelo. Check the advertised departure point, total driving time and current inclusions carefully; if you are already in Kutaisi, ask whether a pickup there can be arranged rather than assuming it is offered.

If you choose Okatse or Kinchkha, ask about their own walking demands and conditions. Martvili's short circuit does not tell you how strenuous the next stop will be. For a multi-stop tour, request the actual time allowed at each attraction and identify which stop can be dropped if delays build up.
